'''Oratay''' was a fruit that was native to [[Cilpar]] and other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It could be made into a [[brown]]-colored beverage. [[Ronk/Legends|Ronks]] were known to be allergic to it. It could be ground into a disk and then thrown at the ronks to keep them away. But, it took six months to gather enough grounds to press a disk.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|418|oratay}}</ref>
